entries.en: Dametta needs someone to gather microchu leaflets for her cooking.
entries.fr: Dametta cherche un condiment particulier pour préparer sa recette. Cela semble assez urgent...
entries.ja: ハーストミルの主婦アメッタは、料理の味付けに使うコチューの若葉を必要としているようだ。

entries.en: Dametta of Hyrstmill is making a batch of Mun<-->Tuy tonic, a nutritious but notoriously foul-tasting drink. If she could get her hands on some microchu leaflets to flavor the concoction, however, she could render it palatable for normal folk. Slay the microchus surrounding Hyrstmill and gather four leaflets from their remains.

entries.fr:
Dametta vous a demandé de lui rapporter des feuilles de microtyugh pour parfumer son lait de Mun-Tuy.
Terrassez les microtyughs qui rôdent près du Moulin des Bois et récupérez quatre jeunes feuilles de microtyugh.
entries.ja: ムントゥイ豆乳の味付けに使うコチューの若葉が足りないらしい。ハーストミル付近にいる「コチュー」を倒し、「コチューの若葉」を4枚集めよう。

entries.en: You've gathered four microchu leaflets. Deliver them to Dametta posthaste, before she makes some hapless soul drink the unadulterated brew!
entries.fr:
Vous avez récupéré les quatre jeunes feuilles de microtyugh demandées.
Rendez-vous sans attendre au Moulin des Bois et remettez-les à Dametta.
entries.ja: コチューの若葉を集め終えた。急ぎ、ハーストミルで待つ「アメッタ」に届けよう。

entries.en: To respect the forest and take only that which is needed, to lead a life without waste─such is the tenet by which Gridanians live. Dametta stresses the importance of this belief, before lamenting that her son has yet to take it to heart...
entries.fr: Dametta vous a expliqué que les ressources de la nature sont précieuses et qu'il convient d'y puiser avec parcimonie, en fonction de nos besoins. Elle espère que son fils, qui a tendance à jouer avec la nourriture, finira par comprendre lui aussi...
entries.ja: すべては森からの頂きものだからこそ、必要なものを必要なだけ、必要なときに使うのが大切だというアメッタ。その信条が、彼女の息子にも受け継がれるといいのだが……。

近くに「コチュー」がいたのを見ただろう。

entries.en: I'm whipping up a fresh batch of Mun<-->Tuy tonic, you see. Oh, it's a <italic(1)>lovely<italic(0)> drink, absolutely bursting with nutrients and goodness. I'll have you know I always drink at least one cup a day! Alas, few people share my <italic(1)>passion<italic(0)> for healthy living... Truth be told, most won't touch the stuff─not unless you add microchu leaflets, anyway. Apparently, the taste and the smell are too distracting or some such nonsense.

今作ってる、ムントゥイ豆乳の香りつけに必要なのさ。
このままじゃ青臭くって飲めやしないよ。

entries.en: Oh, but listen to me prattling on like an Ishgardian priest! I shall stop talking and start stirring! Well, don't just stand there, dear─run along and fetch me those leaves! This batch will be ready soon, and it'd be <italic(1)>such<italic(0)> a shame if no one could drink it but me.

entries.ja: あら、もうコチューの若葉を集めてきたのかい？

entries.en: Let's see... Yes, that's four, alright! \<sniff> \<sniff> Ah, such a <italic(1)>lovely<italic(0)> scent!

うん、いい香りだ。

entries.en: Now, you gathered only the four I asked for, and not one more, yes? Oh, I know I shouldn't have to ask, but these days, more and more people forget to take only what they need. If we're to live in harmony with the wood, we must respect life and remember what it means to take it.
entries.fr: Les ingrédients qu'on récupère sur les bêtes sauvages sont eux aussi des dons de la nature. Comme le reste, il convient de ne pas abuser de ces précieuses ressources.
entries.ja:
生き物から頂く食材も、
森が与えてくれたものだからねぇ。
必要以上に取りすぎないことも、大事なのよ。

entries.en: <italic(1)>Never be wasteful<italic(0)>! Know the value of life and know the value of our time here in this world. That's why I always live my life to the fullest, wasting nary a moment and nary a word─nay, not so much as a single one!

entries.fr: Voilà pourquoi, nous autres Gridaniens, profitons des richesses de la Sylve uniquement lorsque c'est nécessaire.
entries.ja:
だからこそ、無駄にしないように、
必要な時、必要なだけの量を頂くのさ。

entries.en: Remember: if you mean to remain within the Twelveswood, you must be ever mindful to show respect and gratitude to the forest and to the elementals.
entries.fr: N'oubliez jamais que c'est grâce à la forêt et aux esprits que nous pouvons survivre et, pour cela, il convient de se montrer re<->con<->nais<->sant de leur bienveillance.
entries.ja:
あんたもね、ここにいる限り、
森と精霊への感謝の気持ちを忘れちゃいけないよ。

entries.en: You know, you remind me of my son. He's a good boy, but sometimes forgets what it means to be Gridanian. Why, just the other day, I caught him and his friends throwing Mun<-->Tuy beans at each other!
entries.macro: You know, you remind me of my son. He's a good boy, but sometimes forgets what it means to be Gridanian. Why, just the other day, I caught him and his friends throwing Mun<-->Tuy beans at each other!
entries.fr: En parlant de ça, l'autre jour, j'ai surpris mon fils en train de s'amuser avec des fèves de Mun-Tuy. Bien entendu, je l'ai grondé et je lui ai expliqué que c'était mal de jouer avec la nourriture.
entries.ja:

この間……うちの子ったらムントゥイ豆を…………
友達と……………………………………投げ…………

entries.en: Needless to say, I was terribly cross─who wouldn't be?─and all set to give them a memorable scolding, when I noticed they were playing in teams, and that <italic(1)>my son<italic(0)> was leading the winners!
entries.macro: Needless to say, I was terribly cross─who wouldn't be?─and all set to give them a memorable scolding, when I noticed they were playing in teams, and that <italic(1)>my son<italic(0)> was leading the winners!
entries.fr: Mais pour être honnête avec vous, son imagination m'a stupéfaite. Le jeu qu'il a inventé avec son ami était très bien fichu et je me suis dit qu'il avait peut-être un don.
entries.speaker: DAMETTA

entries.en: Oh, I know I shouldn't have been proud, but when I saw the way he marshaled his troops─by which I mean his friends─it was so <italic(1)>clear<italic(0)> to me that he was a born leader... Ah, where was I? Oh, yes! You see, later that day, I was cooking dinner and he, quite without prompting, offered to wash the vegetables! He's <italic(1)>such<italic(0)> a good boy, you know...
